Lok Adalat.definition: Statutory alternative dispute resolution forum organized under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 for amicable settlement of banking disputes and recovery claims.
Lok Adalat.statutory_context: Banking Ombudsman Scheme and NPA recovery guidelines.

Kisan Credit Card.definition: Pioneered credit mechanism designed to provide adequate and timely credit to farmers for agricultural operational needs and post-harvest expenses.

SARFAESI.definition: Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002 empowering banks and ARCs to enforce security interest without court intervention.
SARFAESI.statutory_context: Asset Reconstruction Companies and recovery directions.

Jan Dhan.definition: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) National Mission for Financial Inclusion providing universal access to banking facilities and Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA).

e-Mandate.definition: Electronic recurring payment mandate framework with Additional Factor of Authentication (AFA) and pre-transaction notification requirements.
e-Mandate.statutory_context: Payment and Settlement Systems Act directions issued by DPSS.
